approval_asked.description: getBill only: the pending request to post or void it.

checks.description: getBill only: what stops a draft posting (✖), and the warnings it posts with (⚠).

due_date.description: When it falls due: as entered, or from the payment terms.

fx_rate.description: The rate typed on the document, if one was.

input_tax.description: The facts its input tax is decided from, every one stated (FR-AP-20).

input_tax_decisions.description: getBill only: how each line's input tax was decided, one a line in order (FR-AP-20).

kind.description: bill, or vendor_credit: a supplier's credit note, posted as a bill's reverse (FR-AP-03).

ledger_impact.description: getBill only: the lines posting it writes (a draft), or wrote (posted): debits positive.

nature_of_payment.description: What the payment is for, for a supplier resident outside Singapore (FR-AP-19).

number.description: Its number from the bill sequence: given when it posts, or when it is saved if the sequence is not gap-free (FR-ORG-04).

open.description: A posted bill: what is still to pay of it, in its currency: its total less what payments settle (FR-AR-18).

payable.description: What it adds to accounts payable in the base currency (a vendor credit: what it takes off): as posted, or as posting would post it; absent while it cannot post.

payments.description: getBill only: the payments that settle it, earliest first, each marked when it was voided.

releases.description: getBill only: the monthly releases of its spread lines (FR-GL-03), by line and month, each with its state; the months still to come are projections, not in the ledger (ENG-05).

states.description: Its approval, ledger, payment and due states.

status.description: Draft (✎), posted, or reversed by a void.

supplier_ref.description: The supplier's own number for it.

total.description: Every line's net and GST, in the bill's currency.

version.description: The version of its content; with the status it makes the ETag.

withholding.description: getBill only, for a supplier resident outside Singapore: how withholding tax stands (FR-AP-19).
